item.title: Police investigating nonfatal shooting in Hartford
item.description: Police said the gunshot victim, a man in his 30s, was alert and conscious when he arrived at the hospital.

item.title: Used EVs under $25,000 propel sales even as new models languish
item.description: EV batteries are proving to be more durable than expected.

item.title: Alysa Liu surges into medal range as US teammates stumble in Olympic short program
item.description: Alysa Liu is left to carry the hopes of the “Blade Angels” into the women’s free skate at the Milan Cortina Olympics as the only one of American’s vaunted figure skating trio to put herself in contention for gold after the short program on Tuesday night.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 18, 2026
item.description: A soft and tender vibe is likely today. As the sensitive Pisces Moon meets romantic Venus, we may be drawn to kindness, simple pleasures, and smoothing rough edges. We’ll probably be more interested in feeling good than in finding the cold, hard facts. Then, at 10:52 am EST, the radiant Sun enters Pisces, shifting our focus toward empathy, imagination, and quieter leadership that invites cooperation. When feelings have room to breathe, all kinds of bonds between people can grow!

item.title: Judge blocks deportation of Palestinian activist who led protests at Columbia
item.description: The judge said she terminated the case because of a procedural misstep by government attorneys.

item.title: FBI, St. Paul police probing ICE arrest that resulted in skull fractures
item.description: ICE said he caused the injury when he tried to run while handcuffed and fell.

item.title: NASA hopes fuel leaks are fixed as it launches another countdown test for the Artemis II moonshot

item.title: Key quotes from the Rev. Jesse Jackson that define his politics and legacy
item.description: He was known as one of the Civil Rights Movement's most dynamic orators.

item.title: State police identify woman fatally struck by SUV on Route 2 in Preston
item.description: State police said the 33-year-old Norwich woman was walking on Route 2 when she was struck by a Subaru.

item.title: CT man found sitting with shotgun on front stoop accused of threatening person in ongoing dispute
